summary: Microsoft pulled out as anchor tenant of Nscale's planned GBP 2bn Loughton (Essex) AI data centre after grid power was pushed to the 2030s; Nscale says other Microsoft contracts are unaffected. It's a single-site, UK-specific setback rather than a change to Microsoft's AI spend, so only a slight negative. Tech led Monday's rebound (Nasdaq +1.1%). Earnings season for big tech is the bigger driver ahead.
catalyst_note: Microsoft exits Nscale Loughton UK data centre lease over grid delays (reported 19-20 Oct)
